summary: Re-measured ov-optimum, ov-spec, ov-dist-spec on alpha (Battlemage B390) and charlie (Arc 140V Lunar Lake). Single-node numbers ~50% below saved main baselines; distributed ov-dist-spec matches baseline. Two surprises: alpha B390 < charlie 140V (perf inversion); ov-spec accept rate fell from 0.91 to 0.50.
